title: GPT-5 vs Claude Sonnet: Which AI Model Should You Use in 2026?
summary: GPT-5 vs Claude Sonnet — a full benchmark breakdown for developers. Compare coding, pricing, context windows, and real-world use cases for 2026.
body_markdown: Claude Sonnet 4.5 is generally preferred for autonomous agents. It scores 61.4% on OSWorld computer use tasks, and Anthropic has documented 30+ hour sustained autonomous sessions. Its stronger instruction-following and lower failure rate in chained agentic steps make it the standard choice for Claude Code, Cursor, and multi-step agent pipelines.
